title: Welcome to Strawberry Jam
description: Strawberry Jam is a powerful tool for exploring and extending Animal Jam Classic. This tutorial will guide you through the key features to help you get started.

title: Console Tab
description: The Console tab is where you'll interact with Strawberry Jam using commands. Type commands in the input field at the bottom. Available commands include 'servers', 'end', and 'terminate'. Plugins may add their own commands. Use Tab for autocomplete!

title: Network Tab
description: The Network tab shows all packets sent between your game and Animal Jam's servers. You can filter by All, Incoming, or Outgoing packets. This is useful for analyzing game communication.

title: Command Input
description: This is the command input field. Type commands here and press Enter to execute them. Available commands include 'servers' (check Animal Jam server status), 'end' (end AJ Classic processes), and 'terminate' (free ports 443/8080). Plugins may add their own commands. Use Tab for autocomplete!

title: Plugin System
description: Plugins extend Strawberry Jam's functionality. UI plugins open windows, while Game plugins add commands. The colored dots show plugin status: green (active), red (inactive), yellow (game plugin).

title: Plugin Information
description: Each plugin has an info icon (ℹ️) that appears when you hover over it. Click this icon to see detailed information about the plugin, including its description, author, and available commands or features.

title: Launching the Game
description: Click 'Strawberry Jam' to launch Animal Jam Classic. The connection status indicator at the bottom shows if you're connected. Make sure the game is launched through Strawberry Jam for plugins to work.

title: Settings
description: Access Settings from the sidebar to customize Strawberry Jam. You can configure themes, connection options, and plugin-specific settings. Many features can be customized to your preferences.

title: Links Section
description: The Links section provides quick access to important resources like the Discord server, documentation, and other helpful links related to Strawberry Jam and the community.

title: Plugin Library
description: The Plugin Library lets you browse and discover new plugins for Strawberry Jam. You can find plugins created by the community, see what they do, and install them to extend functionality.

title: Theme Customization
description: Click the fruit icon in the header to cycle through different themes. Each theme changes the color scheme and gives Strawberry Jam a unique look. You can also customize themes in Settings.

title: You're All Set!
description: You've learned the basics of Strawberry Jam! Explore plugins, try commands, and customize your experience. Need help? Check the Discord server or browse the Links section for resources.
